notes: Only the start of each course is free now. Croatian gives away all of level A0 and Portuguese its first fifteen lessons, and everything past that is a one-time unlock. The free window is counted from the first lesson of the course rather than from wherever you are, so a placement test can no longer land you deep in a paid level with fifteen free lessons in front of you. Unlocks are now per language: buying a level in Croatian no longer opens it in Portuguese. The B2 product is gone, because neither course has a B2 lesson to sell.
